editorial: Official Showtime footage illustrates Peach fighting stage enemies; Bowser is identified separately. Tennis and kart use authored game-selection cards because the package contains no such gameplay. The 2018 Super Crown transformation is illustrated with correctly named TOADETTE to PEACHETTE diagrams; the package contains no official transformation footage. Bowsette is consistently labelled fan-made, distinct from Peach and Peachette. Supplied Smash Bowsette footage is fan-made, not an official announcement. Adult-content references use wholly opaque authored cards. Crops of supplied portraits focus on faces.
unused: AI Peach portrait, fan-song animation, the Rosalina animation and unselected originals remain outside Git. Raw archive, ASR and personal gesture reference are not published.
